startObjectsNote: The 63 pins and 56 cups sit in the CAD exactly where they start a match: 37 pins + 36 cups on the field, 20 cups + 26 pins in the red/blue staging areas.  Those numbers match the official VEXcode VR Playground object inventory exactly, and the 21 locations match its GPS table to within 2 mm, so this IS the official opening layout -- not a packing arrangement.  position = [x, y, base height] in the field frame (mm), halves = [lower, upper] by physical height, axis = the piece's axis (lower -> upper) so lying pieces can be drawn correctly.
